task.description: Evidence from a live run on outfeed 2026-10-28 (miter clones --path outfeed --min-lines 20): 108 functions analysed, 32 pairs at similarity >= 0.90, of which 30 are test functions and only 2 are production code. The two production pairs are not actionable: mcp_sync.rs:20 (23 lines) vs synthesis.rs:47 (29 lines), and sync.rs:14 (22 lines) vs push.rs:34 (96 lines), both reported at 90.6% - a 22-line and a 96-line function cannot be a structural clone, so the metric is scale-invariant and a size-ratio guard is missing. Additional gaps: JSON emits similarity as a string ("1.0000") plus hamming_distance, which is awkward for typed consumers; there is no exclude/include filter, so tests/ and *_tests.rs dominate every report and bury production duplication; and there is no per-repository summary, making a workspace-wide scan hard to read. Proposed: emit similarity as a number; skip pairs whose line counts differ by more than ~25% (or report them separately); exclude test paths by default with an explicit --include-tests opt-in; add --exclude globs; and add a summary grouped by repository with a count of production vs test pairs. Acceptance: a workspace-wide run reports production duplication without test noise, no pair where one side is more than 25% longer than the other, and similarity is a JSON number.
task.title: Make miter clones trustworthy as a suite-wide duplication gate

receipt.summary: Merged to miter main (20fa45a): find_clones now requires the shorter body to be at least 75% of the longer (a scale-invariant SimHash cannot separate sizes), the CLI skips test code by default across the whole walk with an --include-tests opt-in, similarity is emitted as a JSON number, and both table and JSON report production_pairs/test_pairs. Stale help text that named .miter/miter.redb now names .gaugeblock/miter/miter.redb with the legacy fallback noted. Measured effect on outfeed: from 32 pairs (30 test, 2 bogus) to 1 production pair and 0 test pairs. Gates: clippy --workspace --all-targets -D warnings clean, nextest --workspace 232/232 (3 new guard tests), fmt and docs clean.
